title: Rank-respecting augmentation of hypergraphs with negamodular constraints

statement.text:
Given a [[supermodular function|crossing negamodular]] function <math>R:2^V\to
\mathbb{Z}</math> such that <math>R(X)\ne 1</math> for every
<math>X\subseteq V</math> and a hypergraph
<math>G_0=(V,\mathcal{E}_0)</math>, find a hypergraph
<math>G=(V,\mathcal{E})</math> of minimum total size such that
<math>d_G(X)\ge R(X)-d_{G_0}(X)</math> holds for every
<math>X\subseteq V</math> and the rank of <math>G</math> does not
exceed the rank of <math>G_0</math>.

status_observation.evidence: pinned EGRES Open MediaWiki revision and categories
